arguments.question: For NVDA over 21/63 sessions, use the latest FOMC statement/projections and other primary Fed material available to establish the current monetary-policy stance, stated inflation/employment risks, and scheduled policy transmission relevant to long-duration technology valuations and AI-infrastructure financing. Do not assert NVDA-specific exposure absent issuer evidence. Required evidence: dated primary Fed disclosures; distinguish facts from general transmission inference. Stop after determining whether policy conditions create a material, measurable NVDA-specific channel or only an unquantified valuation/financing channel.
arguments.decision_impact: Could change the draft if policy evidence indicates an imminent stance shift or financial-conditions risk that plausibly interacts with issuer-disclosed customer financing dependence; otherwise it bounds macro risk without a numeric NVDA haircut.
